verdict.rationale: Omarchy is a desktop Linux distribution, so remote desktop sharing and access is a fair axis for it. The evidence pack documents no screen-sharing, VNC/RDP server, or remote-desktop client capability. The only related items are SSH port forwarding via `fip` and an open SSH port in the firewall, which are adjacent features and not remote desktop sessions.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can share my desktop remotely or access a remote desktop session from my machine
